_source: Decreto Ministeriale 23 dicembre 1976, 'Sistemi di codificazione dei soggetti da iscrivere all'anagrafe tributaria', Art. 7 'Carattere alfabetico di controllo' — Gazzetta Ufficiale della Repubblica Italiana n. 345 del 29 dicembre 1976, Supplemento ordinario, p. 5 (primary source, scanned image read on 2026-10-10)
_rule: Art. 7: each of the first fifteen characters is converted to a numeric value according to whether it occupies an EVEN (pari, 7 characters: 2nd, 4th, ... 14th) or ODD (dispari, 8 characters: 1st, 3rd, ... 15th) position; the values are added and the sum is divided by 26; the control character is the letter corresponding to the remainder in the final table.
_purpose: BANK-001-06 / D-11: `fiscal_code_like` values in this corpus are synthetic and MUST FAIL this check (and/or the 16-character shape) so they can never be mistaken for a real codice fiscale. The lint verifies it (rule CF-LIKE-INVALID).
